scripts.build: node -e "const fs=require('fs'),cp=require('child_process'); if(fs.existsSync('frontend')){ cp.execSync('cd frontend && npm install && npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'}); }else{ cp.execSync('npm run build',{stdio:'inherit'}); fs.mkdirSync('frontend',{recursive:true}); fs.cpSync('dist','frontend/dist',{recursive:true}); }"
